subject: Add to delta 3 (audit residual risks on 0aaffe3)
body: render: (a) keep the runtime-sampler refusal under #ifndef NORD2_JM_TRANSPORT (non-JM builder would silently use word 0); (b) tegu_render_generic_variant_select is unlocked — two app threads encoding against one pipeline can race compile/slot/count: add a pipeline lock around lookup+compile+publish, readers keep acquire loads (also 2140/2195). compute: optional — when the v2 plan holds only buffer descriptors, one region, mode 0, fall back to the hardware-qualified TGP1/TDG1 path even if unused textures/samplers are bound.
